negative_findings.description: Searched in Hungarian and English for a data.gov.hu-style national open-data portal hosting machine-readable payment/card/ATM datasets. The Hungarian landscape is a public-data cadastre and metadata search (kozadatportal.hu, opendata.gov.hu, kozadat.hu) rather than a CKAN dataset store, and no payment/card dataset was actually observed in them during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portals identified as pointers, but no concrete HU payment dataset record confirmed inside them.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-promising open-data coverage; the operational archive for HU payment series remains MNB's own archive plus web archives.

negative_findings.description: No established Hungarian-language term or portal convention was found for 'discontinued/withdrawn dataset' beyond MNB's own 'archív tartalmak' and KSH's 'archív' labelling; there is no HU equivalent of a formal dataset-deprecation registry.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local vocabulary limited to 'archív tartalmak', 'megszűnt tábla', 'korábbi idősor'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must lean on those three phrases; broader deprecation vocabulary will not retrieve HU results.

negative_findings.description: The OSZK national web archive, the strongest local complement to the Internet Archive, is largely closed for copyright reasons with only three small public sub-collections.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access requires a research arrangement via webarchivum@oszk.hu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated recovery of withdrawn HU bank/MNB pages from the national archive is not possible; Wayback remains the only self-serve route.

negative_findings.description: Pre-1990 Hungarian statistical yearbooks are digitised but sit behind the Arcanum ADT subscription; no free full-text route was found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-run cash/monetary baselines are obtainable only with an institutional subscription or via KSH Library.

negative_findings.description: opendata.hu was described in the sources mainly in past tense and its current liveness was not established. Recorded as unverified, not dead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis: possibly dormant; requires a deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids recording a false negative for a catalogue that may still mirror withdrawn HU datasets.

brief: For Hungary, the archival layer of payment/banking statistics is unusually well anchored: the MNB itself operates an explicit 'Archív tartalmak' section under Pénzforgalmi adatok that preserves 2001-2013 card-business, ATM/POS acceptance, chip-migration, interbank-turnover and card-fraud series that no longer appear in the live tables, and the ECB Data Portal keeps the discontinued PSS/Blue Book dataset with harmonised pre-2014 HU card and terminal series (API-only). Beyond these two anchors, recovery depends on web archives — the Internet Archive for mnb.hu and giro.hu (whose BKR turnover PDFs rotate off opaque storage URLs), since the Hungarian national web archive at OSZK is largely closed for copyright reasons. The Hungarian open-data layer is a cadastre/metadata-search stack (kozadatportal.hu, opendata.gov.hu, kozadat.hu) rather than a dataset store, so it functions as a pointer to holders rather than a download source, while KSH's STADAT archive, yearbooks and Statisztikai Szemle archive supply the historical and methodological trail. Priority actions are a file-level manifest of the six MNB archive sub-pages and a Wayback CDX sweep of the core HU payment domains.
